newsitem.title: USA: Innovo begins opeartions at new plant.
newsitem.headline: Innovo begins opeartions at new plant.

text.p: Innovo Group Inc said Friday that its Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee plant began sewing operations for Innovo on November 5, 1996.
Innovo said the facility is currently dedicating 100 percent of its capacity to completing a large Wal-Mart order for craft products.
The company said it doubled its sewing capacity with a low-cost 36-month lease for the fully-equipped plant in Red Boiling Springs.
Innovo said it is now in a position to accept larger and more profitable orders.
Innovo Group manufactures fashion and sports-licensed bags and other nylon and canvas products for the crafts industry.
